foot: Stock leaves only by a governed count, write-off, transfer or return. A held batch cannot be dispensed. Costs are shown to the Director only.

tools.label: How it is worked out

tabs.label: On order

tabs.label: Transfers

tabs.label: Expiring and held

tabs.label: Receive delivery
tabs.note: Receiving PO-00318 from Supplier A · Delivery reference (DO no.) DO-2231 · received by Siti · 18 Nov, 09:52. 4 lines on this order · 2 ready · 2 need approval · 1,180 units counted. Stock for exception lines posts only after someone other than the receiver approves them. Rules: a delivery reference is required; every lot needs the real expiry from the box; accepted + quarantined + rejected must equal what arrived; a wrong item is rejected, never swapped in. Each lot records batch, expiry (from the box), accepted, quarantined, rejected and total paid for this lot (RM, optional).

tabs.label: Supplier invoices
tabs.note: Record the supplier's invoice against its purchase order. KPOne compares each line with what was ordered, what was received and what it cost (three-way match). Any difference waits for a Finance Officer or Director who did not record it. KPOne pays nothing: a matched or accepted invoice is ready to pay outside KPOne. Recorded by a CA Supervisor or Finance Officer; approved by a Finance Officer or Director. Invoice amounts are shown only to a Director or Finance Officer.

tabs.label: Controlled register
tabs.note: Draft register — pending pharmacist review. Not a statutory register until a pharmacist approves its format. Controlled medicines at Cheras, from the stock records. A medicine appears here once it is marked controlled in the Medicine catalogue and linked to a SKU. Every movement in or out of this branch is listed with a running balance. A check is signed by a second person: not anyone who recorded a movement since the last check, and not whoever did the last check. A check never changes stock. Quantities stay hidden until you record your count, so your check does not depend on the register.

tabs.label: Pack checks
tabs.note: A checked pack conversion per SKU lets Dispensary hand out whole packs (bottles). Stock stays counted in the base unit: 10 bottles is 600 ml when a bottle holds 60. Anyone who manages stock items proposes; only a CA Supervisor or the Director checks, never the proposer. The check is blind: count the physical pack and type the number; do not copy the legacy pack fields. A wrong count is refused. The conversion in use stays as it is until a new one is checked. Nothing is deleted.

tools.label: Show slow-moving stock
tools.done: showing slow-moving stock: more than 120 days on hand, or stock with no use in the period · 4 of 11 (demo). Press again to show all stock.

tools.label: What the columns mean
tools.done: Used is what was dispensed or used in a treatment room in the period. Days on hand is the usable stock now ÷ the average use a day. Turnover is used ÷ the average stock held. Expiry loss is the stock written off as expired ÷ (used + all write-offs). No money figures: stock value waits for the clinic's cost policy. Quantities only.
